text_block_list.text: I arrived at the shrine together with Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I just haven't been in the groove lately...
Figured relying on the gods once in a while wouldn't hurt."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I used to think relying on others like that was super uncool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Still, in this delinquent manga I've been reading lately...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When the protagonist went to duel the top dog from another school,
his delinquent pal prayed for his victory at a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Even though they usually talk with their fists,they were praying so earnestly for the protagonist.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I guess there are some feelings you can convey
even without putting them into words or actions.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's not really like me, but...
I felt a real fire burning deep in my chest.
choice_data_list: That's a nice scene, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh... Told ya!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
I'm gonna make a fiery, super cool prayer!
I prayed with all my heart that Vodka's condition would improve as well.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —I made sure to say a solid prayer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Pops and everyone, the folks at the dorm...
and of course, you too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Oh?
I feel some kind of power bubbling up...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I'm itching to run!
I feel like I could leave everyone in the dust at blazing speed again!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could it be... you were the one
who said a prayer for me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: She was praying super intensely next to me, though...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Guess I gotta thank 'em, at least.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

It seems the blessing worked,
and Vodka was in high spirits.
I prayed with all my heart that I could succeed as a Trainer as well.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —That should about do it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Next time I come, I'm gonna slam down an even
more fiery prayer, so you'd better be ready!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well then, time to head on back――

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...?
What are those guys up to?

Looking in the direction Vodka glanced at,
there is a couple flirting with each other.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Kh!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Pfft! M-My nose is bleeding...!
Whoa, my face is burning up too—?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I came here for a change of pace... but ended up having an awful time... *sigh*.

After getting a relentless nosebleed,
Vodka ended up totally exhausted...
